Subject: An open evening for shared verse

Our summer circle is coming together again, and we would love to meet new readers. Join us when our reading club meets August 7 in Room 2 for an informal hour of listening and discussion. Newcomers are encouraged to bring a poem that feels worth passing along to the room.
